$comment: LLM provider config for the TrustResume agents. Switch providers here (or override any field with env vars). provider: bedrock | openai | google | test. Bedrock (AWS Claude) is the default and uses AWS credentials, not an api_key. model=null uses the provider default. api_key is OPTIONAL and only for openai/google — prefer leaving it null and setting OPENAI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY in the environment; do NOT commit a real key (see config/llm.local.json).
$comment_temperature: temperature is pinned (not left to the provider's default) because three of the four LLM steps are structured extraction/classification, where sampling variance turns into an unreproducible Trust score. Override with TRUSTRESUME_LLM_TEMPERATURE.
$comment_roles: roles tiers models by job: extraction (Job Description + Candidate Profile agents), writer (Resume Writer), verifier (Trust Harness). Each entry may set model, temperature, or both; anything omitted inherits the base values above. Env overrides: TRUSTRESUME_LLM_<ROLE>_MODEL / _TEMPERATURE. Example — cheap extraction, warmer prose, strong verifier: {"extraction": {"model": "gpt-4o-mini"}, "writer": {"temperature": 0.6}}.
